reasoning_summary: The Reynolds number is consistent. U·D/ν = 0.15·0.01/1.5e-5 = 100, which matches the configured value of 100. The force reference values (magUInf 0.15, lRef 0.01, Aref 0.0001, rhoInf 1.2) are consistent with the stated setup.

The inlet was measured as uniform: ux_min = ux_max = 0.15 and uy_max_abs = 0. The domain is large (40D upstream, 60D downstream, 60D half-height). Blockage is 0.0083333 and the stream is treated as unbounded, so confinement effects should be small.

The mesh is adequate for a laminar 2D case. It has 200 cells around the cylinder and a first wall cell of 0.003957D. checkMesh passed, with max non-orthogonality 43.656 deg and max skewness 0.5375. The scheme is second-order (backward in time, linearUpwind in space) with max Courant 0.64796 and 872.03 steps per shedding period.

The temporal record is clean. The run is oscillating, with 13 stationary cycles. Mean Cd in the stationary window is 1.3277, against 1.3278 for the submitted setup. The 95% CI is 1.0366e-05, relative drift is -2.9076e-05 and the half-window difference is -1.6483e-05. All are far below the 3% tolerance, so the Cd statistics are well converged.

St is 0.16382 from both the period count (1/(872.03·0.007)) and the FFT, so the two estimates agree. The nominal frequency resolution is 0.013334, which is coarse against a 3% tolerance. However, the identical non-bin-quantized value from both methods and the 13 clean cycles suggest the peak is well located.

Caveats keep confidence at MEDIUM. There is no mesh or domain refinement study, since only one run exists. The stationary-window start is at the MSER cap. The coarse wake spacing (last wake cell 0.96749D) is untested. Nothing in the evidence shows a defect, so I accept.
